The '''mission to Doan''' was undertaken by [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] in [[980 BBY]] to investigate the recent [[Massacre on Doan|assassination]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]]. A short time previously, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] had traveled to [[Doan]] in search of some recently [[Mining/Legends|excavated]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. After confronting the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Quano]], he forced Quano to lead him to the miner who had dug up the artifacts, [[Draado]]. Harth then killed the other miners present before attacking Draado, killing him and taking the artifacts from him.

Zannah arrived soon after, and from asking several miners about Tandar she learned that someone else had previously been there asking the same questions. Zannah was still looking to take on an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] before she confronted her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], and so she decided to find this man and see if he could join her. She found Quano, and convinced him to take her to one of his contacts, [[Pommat]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Doan. From Pommat, she learned that the man who had previously come to Doan had since left for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. However, Pommat also detailed to her his smuggling business, in which he hacked into [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and concealed [[Spice/Legends|spice]] shipments in them, which would then be picked up by one of his contacts when it returned to its [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] port. When Zannah asked if he had concealed one such shipment on her [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the [[Victory (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Victory'']], he replied that he had not done so, as he did not yet have any contacts on [[Ciutric IV]]. Zannah hen instantly killed Pommat and Quano, as she could not allow anyone to know where she was from, as it would endanger the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]].

Zannah then used several of her other contacts to find out that the man's name was Set Harth. She then tracked Harth to [[Set Harth's mansion|his mansion]] on Nal Hutta, where she [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|confronted]] him and enlisted him as her apprentice.
